messages.subject: inla.posterior.sample.eval() with SRF
parts:
Hi
I am trying to predict from fitted model with a SRF.
Two short example code-files are attached to explain where I run into problems.
- First code (in "TestModel1.R") demonstrates the approach. Simple model with one smoother, without SRF. Prediction using inla.posterior.sample.eval() works fine.
- Second code ( in "TestModel2.R"): Simple dataset with position (X, Y) and a response variable. There is a plot in the code. When I get to the part where I call inla.posterior.sample.eval() and define 'fun', I am lost. Håvard told me to pass in the A-object. But how? See comment in code.
Help on this would be much appreciated.
I am using R-4.2.1, inla 22.05.07, RStudio, Windows.
Best regards
Teunis
